description: Kazhydromet, Kazakhstan's national hydrometeorological service, gathers its public maps and databases on one page. The page read on 2026-09-28 links an interactive air quality map, an interactive surface water quality map, real-time meteorological monitoring data, a meteorological database, a hydrological database, an interactive hydrological monitoring map, radiation monitoring and an interactive soil quality map, next to menu entries for the SILAM air quality forecast model and the state climate cadastre. Coverage is Kazakhstan's observation networks. Access is free on the web; the footer reserves all rights and no data licence was read. Caveats: in round 1 the hydrological database host did not answer the cloud session, so the station coverage, periods and export options of the databases are unconfirmed, and the pages are in Kazakh and Russian. It supports hazard and climate adaptation studies, such as using river level and discharge records for spring flood analysis of settlements and dams, or water quality maps to screen drinking water sources. No related Kazakh hydrometeorological record is catalogued.
